name: University of Oxford
typicalOffer: A*A*A, A*s in Mathematics and Further Mathematics (if available); if Further Maths unavailable: A*AAa with A* in Maths and a in AS Further Maths, or A*AA with A* in Maths
notes: 4-year BA/MMath Mathematics and Philosophy; covers logic, set theory, foundations of mathematics and philosophy of science; interview and MAT required; world-leading programme

name: Durham University
typicalOffer: A*AA, including either A*A in any order in Maths and Further Maths at A level, or A* in Maths plus A in AS Further Maths
notes: 4-year BA Mathematics and Philosophy; strong logic and philosophy of mathematics; joint between Maths and Philosophy departments; great for law and academia pathways

name: University of Bristol
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A* in Mathematics (or A*A in Maths and Further Maths with A*AA)
notes: 4-year BSc Mathematics and Philosophy; strong in logic and foundations of mathematics; Bristol Philosophy Department has strong philosophy of science tradition

name: University of Manchester
typicalOffer: A*AA, including A* in Mathematics or Further Mathematics
notes: 4-year MMath Mathematics and Philosophy; Manchester has a strong mathematical logic tradition — home to Alan Turing; covers foundations of maths, logic and philosophy of science

name: University of Warwick
typicalOffer: A*A*A, A* in Mathematics, A* in Further Mathematics and A in a further subject
notes: 4-year MMath Mathematics and Philosophy; Warwick Philosophy Department is internationally respected; covers game theory, logic and philosophy of mathematics

name: University of Leeds
notes: 4-year BA/MMath Mathematics and Philosophy; Leeds Philosophy Department strong in logic and formal epistemology; great for postgraduate philosophy or law

name: King's College London
typicalOffer: AAA, including grade A in Mathematics and Further Mathematics
notes: 3-year BA or 4-year MSci Mathematics and Philosophy; London location; strong in logic, formal epistemology and philosophy of science; excellent law and finance career links
